subject: Invitation to Annual Company Party
body: Dear Team, We are excited to invite you to our annual company party! This year, we will be celebrating our team's hard work and successes at a beautiful venue downtown. There will be food, drinks, music, and great company. Please RSVP by next Friday so we can finalize the guest list and make sure to save the date. We look forward to celebrating with you all! Best regards, The Organizing Committee
